ui_bugs.issue: Tapping [data-testid=mua-placed-no] does NOT hide the [data-testid=mua-details-section] block. Before-and-after screenshots are identical; Yes button retains active blue-border styling and details block with previously entered cuff='3' + '30°' chip stays visible. On subsequent re-tap of mua-placed-yes the cuff value is NOT reset to empty (expected fresh empty rows per spec). Suspect the onPress for mua-placed-no does not fire, OR a data-sync useEffect re-hydrates muaPlaced=true from persisted phase2_data immediately after setMuaPlaced(false). Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase2/[id].tsx:1061-1067 (onPress={() => { setMuaPlaced(false); setMuaDetails({}); }}). Yes toggle works fine — asymmetric.

action_items: Investigate why mua-placed-no onPress does not flip muaPlaced back to false on a case with previously-persisted mua_placed=true. Likely candidates: (a) a useEffect that syncs muaPlaced from procedure?.phase2_data?.mua_placed on every render, overriding the local setState; check for missing dependency array or missing 'don't overwrite user edits' guard. (b) The setMuaDetails({}) call may throw silently and cancel the state update batch; wrap in try/catch. Add a console.log inside the onPress to confirm firing.
Once No-toggle is fixed, retest T3: after fill cuff='3' + chip '30°' → tap No → details should hide → tap Yes → all cuff inputs should be empty and no chip selected.

The Torque Achieved section in the classic form uses positional testIDs 'torque-{idx}' (line 1040) while PhaseStep2TabbedView uses 'torque-{position}' — main agent's review request expected torque-0/torque-1 but the tabbed view (which renders concurrently for zygoma cases) uses position-keyed IDs. success_rate.frontend: 86% (6 of 7 tests pass, 1 partial-fail on No-toggle)

seed_data_creation: None. Login was performed via direct POST /api/auth/login and localStorage seeding to bypass the flaky Expo web login form → then all API calls succeed with 200. Recommend main agent use this pattern for future frontend tests where auth-form races cause 403s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The iter-412 403-on-implant-plan was NOT a persistent backend/auth bug — it was a client-side race condition where axios calls fired before the auth token finished writing to localStorage. Fix in your test harness: after logging in, either wait for a home-screen element (e.g. 'Case Pipeline' text) with 15s+ timeout, OR call /api/auth/login directly with fetch() and seed localStorage keys 'implanr_access_token' + 'implanr_refresh_token' + 'implanr_user' before navigating. All 5 implant positions (ZR1, ZR2, ZL1, PR1, PL1) load correctly and Torque + MUA sections render with correct implantDisplayLabel-prefixed labels. Only remaining functional bug: mua-placed-no toggle does not hide the details section — see action_items[0].
rca_of_issue: The mua-placed-no toggle no-op is likely caused by a useEffect on submit-phase2/[id].tsx that syncs muaPlaced/muaDetails from procedure.phase2_data on every re-render (the case has previously-persisted mua_placed=true from prior iter-412 test writes). When setMuaPlaced(false) fires, the effect immediately re-reads procedure.phase2_data.mua_placed=true and flips it back. Recommended fix: add a 'user has interacted' flag (e.g. muaDirty state) that gates the sync effect, OR only run the sync effect once on mount (empty dep array + one-shot ref).
